boundary.scope: Receiver ACK-service boundary diagnostic: reconstructed queued mixed ACK/DATA inputs, real source MAC packing/airtime, real gateway MAC/HOP/NWK receive-window update, delivery and ACK transmission. Controlled successful transport; no RF collision/half-duplex, source HOP custody, application-admission, routing reconvergence, global timing, PHY/ECC or full-network numerical-parity claim.
boundary.reported_internal_observations: Radio/preamble selections and final internal receive-window/custody readings are reported in check.csv; ACK sequence/bitmap, deliveries, queue drain, timing, scheduling and transport are independently reconciled with raw event tables. No source HOP custody or admission improvement is inferred from this fixture.
